race.comment: BOYD (12) continues to race well deep into the prep. Settled handy then closed well but was no match for Mathematician a fortnight ago over this course and distance. Drops 2kgs in this slightly tougher race. Always hard to beat over this specialist distance. LAKE FOREST (8) is an honest sprinter back from a 15-week spell. Scored a comfortable victory first-up last prep over today's journey at Pakenham Synthetic. Going well in the jump-outs which suggests he is ready for another big run while fresh. DEEPFLOAT DIVA (6) settled last in a small field then worked home well without threatening first-up, clocking in 1.5 lengths behind BOYD who had a race fitness edge. Has a far better second-up record so she can turn the tables. BARDIGRUB (9) last raced on 25 July when third at Listed level behind the class sprinter Cavalry Girl. Placed at two of her three fresh runs and all three career wins have come here at 1000m. TOBIKKO (13) returned in good order last time and is in the mix.
